text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come for Tanino Gimlet's
challenge in the Yasuda Kinen...!
I've waited so long for this day~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "They're all seasoned veterans, but if it's Gimlet, I know she'll shatter all common sense!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Senpai.
Today... I'm going to watch you closely once again."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Witness the determined run... of our senpais!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Do you remember last year's NHK Mile Cup?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Back then, I... instinctively sensed the possibility of my own defeat.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "Ever since I finished the MC Rotation and began scripting a new scenario with you, it feels as though that sensation has rapidly faded into the distance..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —But that's what makes it so great.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Possibility means being undetermined.
Chaos is precisely that beloved future
which encapsulates infinity and eternity...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am becoming chaos itself right now.
...This floating sensation feels truly sublime!
choice_data_list: ...You are chaos and possibility itself, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Chaos and potential shall pave the way...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Destroy common sense! Trample over reason!!
Affirm all possibilities and lead the way!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And the new chaos born from it shall inherit
my destruction and make me eternal...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"This Yasuda Kinen is my signal to the world!
A declaration of my very reason for being!!"
choice_data_list: Let's kick things off with a bang!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, it is time for frenzy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I feel it...! The terrifyingly sharp waves of soul from those who have honed their "speed" to perfection...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(However... among them, there is one
who carries an entirely different presence—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Found you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uhyooo!
It's been two years since my last Yasuda Kinen, and I can't get enough...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's crackling motivation
feels like it's piercing right through my skin...!
It's good for my health!! Far too much of a reward!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (One unbound by the battlefield...! Racing across both turf and dirt, seizing victory in countless graded stakes—a seasoned veteran and an extraordinary marvel...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —O all-seeing Observer, and great Hero who has traversed countless battlefields.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you prepared for your fierce battle record
to clash against the scenario I have written?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hawaah!?
That refined yet magnificent way of speaking... Tanino Gimlet-san...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To have you speak to me directly is the utmost honor!
Yet with Digi-tan's limited vocabulary, can I even properly absorb your blessed words...?! Uwaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(...Frightening. Under all this pressure,
does she not realize how abnormal it is to act so unfazed...?!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Besides—
Is this slightly overflowing anomaly...
that of one who carries destiny...?!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Heh. Is this the fruit of a hundred battles? A power strong enough to bend reason itself... How fascinating...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eep! If you're gonna call someone an 'interestin' horse girl',
I'd really, really prefer you say it to someone
other than Digi-tan, pleeease~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-Nevertheless, this humble Agnes Digital!!
In return for your precious attention,
I shall answer with all my soul out on the track!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then let me savor it to the fullest.
Direct that magnificent "speed" of yours solely toward me today.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I shall answer once more.
With a passion fierce enough to scorch your very soul—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeek...!! Y-Your face is way too cloooose...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...*thud*.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, onward!!
To the battlefield where our "speed" intersects!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees...—
